goal: 为耐药结核（Drug-resistant tuberculosis）寻找可重定位的已上市药物及其作用机制
overview: 二甲双胍通过恢复感染巨噬细胞的自噬流，增强对耐药结核菌的胞内杀伤；齐留通则激活促消退脂质介质程序，减轻空洞性肺损伤而加速炎症缓解，且不削弱细菌遏制。达沙替尼借由抑制Src激酶将结核菌锁定在酸化自噬溶酶体内，限制其播散。在直接杀菌层面，双硫仑破坏甲萘醌合成并放大铜介导的活性氧，不仅直接灭杀耐药菌株，更恢复其对利福平的敏感性。维拉帕米则同时阻断宿主与病原体的钙通道，抑制药物外排，显著提升贝达喹啉的胞内滞留与疗效。上述老药新用从宿主定向疗法到直接抗菌及增敏增效，构成了多靶点协同对抗耐药结核的机制图谱。

hypotheses.b: AMPK-mediated induction of autophagy and phagosomal maturation in macrophages
hypotheses.c: Enhanced intracellular killing of drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis
hypotheses.statement: Metformin adjunctive therapy accelerates clearance of drug-resistant Mtb by restoring autophagic flux in infected macrophages.
hypotheses.rationale: Metformin activates AMPK, which inhibits mTORC1 and promotes TFEB-driven lysosomal biogenesis, critical for mycobacterial killing.

reviews.critique: 需验证对耐药菌株自噬通量的恢复
Host AMPK-autophagy axis well-documented; clinical TB data limited.
AMPK-自噬通路研究较多，耐药菌效果需验证

hypotheses.b: 5-lipoxygenase inhibition skewing the lipid mediator balance from LTB4 toward LXA4
hypotheses.c: Accelerated resolution of inflammation and reduced tissue destruction without compromising Mtb containment
hypotheses.statement: Zileuton limits cavitary lung damage in drug-resistant TB by promoting pro-resolving lipid mediator programs.
hypotheses.rationale: Overactive LTB4 drives necrosis; shifting to resolvins via zileuton promotes non-lytic bacterial clearance and lung healing.

reviews.critique: 5-LO阻断可能影响促消退介质平衡
Pro-resolving lipid mediator shift is creative; TB cavity data lacking.
促脂质介质在结核保护中的作用待验证

hypotheses.b: Host ArfGAP and Src-family kinase inhibition impairing Mtb-containing vacuole escape and cell-to-cell spread
hypotheses.c: Confinement of drug-resistant Mtb within autophagolysosomes and reduced bacterial dissemination
hypotheses.statement: Dasatinib restricts drug-resistant Mtb spread by locking bacilli inside sealed, acidified compartments through Src kinase inhibition.
hypotheses.rationale: Mtb exploits host tyrosine kinases to rupture phagosomes; dasatinib restores membrane integrity by blocking the phagosome-disrupting kinases.

reviews.critique: Src抑制剂安全性与脱靶效应存疑
Src kinase blockade to stop Mtb spread is mechanistically sound, but host-toxic.
Src激酶在Mtb逃逸中角色需确认

hypotheses.b: Inhibition of the bacterial MenE enzyme and simultaneous copper-dependent ROS generation within Mtb
hypotheses.c: Direct killing of drug-resistant Mtb and re-sensitization to rifampicin
hypotheses.statement: Disulfiram exhibits dual bactericidal activity against drug-resistant Mtb by disrupting menaquinone synthesis and amplifying copper-mediated ROS.
hypotheses.rationale: Disulfiram metabolites target the menaquinone biosynthesis pathway and, in the presence of copper, generate lethal oxidative stress.

reviews.critique: 体内铜浓度能否达有效杀菌待验证
MenE and Cu-ROS mechanisms known; rifampicin synergy underexplored.
双硫仑抗结核双重机制已有文献支持

hypotheses.b: Inhibition of macrophage-induced Mtb efflux pumps and membrane potential disruption via L-type calcium channel blockade
hypotheses.c: Increased intracellular retention and efficacy of bedaquiline against drug-resistant Mtb
hypotheses.statement: Verapamil potentiates bedaquiline efficacy by blocking both host and pathogen calcium channels that contribute to drug efflux in drug-resistant TB.
hypotheses.rationale: Mtb exploits host calcium signaling to upregulate efflux; verapamil blocks this and also directly inhibits mycobacterial ATP-dependent transporters.

reviews.critique: 体外增效贝达喹啉明确，需临床转化
Efflux inhibition by verapamil established; bedaquiline synergy logical.
宿主钙通道与药物滞留关联需更多证据

hypotheses.b: Iron chelation-mediated deprivation of mycobacterial siderophore access and inhibition of aconitase in Mtb
hypotheses.c: Bacteriostatic effect on drug-resistant Mtb and synergy with isoniazid despite katG mutations
hypotheses.statement: Deferiprone starves drug-resistant Mtb of iron, resensitizing it to residual isoniazid activity through independent oxidative stress pathways.
hypotheses.rationale: Mtb requires iron for respiration and persistence; deferiprone sequesters labile iron pools essential for mycobactin-dependent acquisition.

reviews.critique: 铁螯合同时伤害宿主巨噬细胞铁代谢
Iron starvation resensitizing INH via oxidative stress is attractive yet unproven.
katG突变致INH无法活化，铁剥夺难恢复

hypotheses.b: Mimicking thioredoxin reductase activity and targeting Mtb TrxB2, alongside host GPX4-dependent ferroptosis inhibition
hypotheses.c: Simultaneous direct killing of drug-resistant Mtb and protection of infected macrophages from ferroptotic death
hypotheses.statement: Ebselen achieves dual action against drug-resistant TB by disrupting Mtb redox homeostasis and blocking ferroptosis in macrophages.
hypotheses.rationale: Ebselen is a glutathione peroxidase mimic that hits Mtb's thioredoxin system while preventing host lipid peroxidation, preserving immune cells.

reviews.critique: 保护感染细胞免于铁死亡或助长菌存活
Dual host-pathogen redox action is clever; host ferroptosis protection may conflict.
对Mtb TrxB2和GPX4双重作用待验证

hypotheses.b: Sigma-1 receptor chaperone-mediated modulation of the host ER stress response
hypotheses.c: Reduced pro-inflammatory necrosis and better containment of drug-resistant Mtb in granulomas
hypotheses.statement: Fluvoxamine preserves granuloma integrity during drug-resistant TB by limiting macrophage necrosis via sigma-1 receptor engagement.
hypotheses.rationale: Sigma-1 receptor agonists attenuate ER stress-induced cell death, preventing necrotic core expansion that benefits extracellular bacilli.

reviews.critique: 氟伏沙明抗坏死作用需肉芽肿模型验证
Sigma-1 chaperone modulation in TB granulomas is fresh but speculative.
Sigma-1在结核坏死中的作用尚未明确

hypotheses.b: COX-2-dependent prostaglandin E2 reduction leading to decreased IL-10 and PD-L1 expression on myeloid cells
hypotheses.c: Reversal of T-cell exhaustion and improved host control of drug-resistant Mtb
hypotheses.statement: Ibuprofen reverses T-cell exhaustion in drug-resistant TB by lowering PGE2-mediated PD-L1 and IL-10 expression.
hypotheses.rationale: PGE2 drives immunosuppressive IL-10 and PD-L1 in TB granulomas; ibuprofen breaks this tolerogenic loop, reinvigorating T-cell responses.

reviews.critique: 长期COX-2抑制或削弱杀菌免疫应答
COX-2/PGE2 axis in T-cell exhaustion is plausible, TB evidence thin.
PGE2调控PD-L1在结核中证据有限

hypotheses.b: Autophagic sequestration coupled with iron deprivation
hypotheses.statement: Co-administration of Dasatinib and Deferiprone achieves synergistic clearance of drug-resistant Mtb by locking bacilli inside autophagolysosomes while simultaneously starving them of iron.
hypotheses.rationale: Dasatinib's Src inhibition forces Mtb into sealed, acidified compartments and Deferiprone's iron chelation deprives the trapped bacteria of essential metal cofactors, overwhelming their stress responses and preventing escape.

reviews.critique: 协同需体内验证，可能加重宿主毒性

hypotheses.b: Histamine H2 receptor blockade on myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) reducing IL-12 suppression
hypotheses.c: Restored Th1 polarization and IFN-γ production against extensively drug-resistant TB
hypotheses.statement: Cimetidine re-establishes Th1 immunity in XDR-TB by depleting H2R-driven immunosuppressive MDSCs.
hypotheses.rationale: Histamine drives MDSC expansion that dampens CTL and Th1 responses via IL-10; cimetidine depletes MDSCs, enabling IFN-γ-mediated killing.

reviews.critique: H2R阻断可能打破免疫平衡致过激炎症
H2R blockade to deplete MDSCs is innovative; human TB data absent.
MDSC上H2受体在TB中研究较少

hypotheses.b: Cell envelope disruption enhances rifampicin activity
hypotheses.c: Targets lipid metabolism, compromising mycobacterial cell wall integrity
hypotheses.statement: Fluoxetine weakens the drug-resistant Mtb cell envelope by disrupting lipid metabolism, thereby enhancing rifampicin penetration and bactericidal action.
hypotheses.rationale: Fluoxetine, an SSRI antidepressant, has membrane-perturbing and anti-biofilm properties that may interfere with mycolic acid and other lipid synthesis in Mtb, breaching the permeability barrier and enabling rifampicin to reach its RNA polymerase target more effectively.
hypotheses.self_novelty: Repurposes a CNS drug to target mycobacterial lipid metabolism, offering a novel synergistic partner for rifampicin against drug-resistant TB beyond conventional ROS or autophagy mechanisms.

reviews.critique: Lipid metabolism disruption to weaken cell wall is plausible, data nascent.
氟西汀抗Mtb的具体脂质靶点不明确

hypotheses.b: Replenishment of intracellular glutathione and direct acetylation of the Mtb virulence protein ESAT-6
hypotheses.c: Neutralization of drug-resistant Mtb virulence and attenuation of necrotic cell death
hypotheses.statement: NAC disarms drug-resistant Mtb by acetylating its pore-forming toxin ESAT-6 while bolstering macrophage glutathione-dependent bactericidity.
hypotheses.rationale: NAC not only restores host redox but chemically modifies ESAT-6, a key pH-dependent pore-forming toxin, reducing its lytic activity.

reviews.critique: 直接乙酰化ESAT-6体内证据不足
ESAT-6 acetylation by NAC is novel; needs in vivo validation.
NAC直接乙酰化ESAT-6缺乏直接证据

hypotheses.b: S1PR1 internalization preventing T-cell egress from lymph nodes and sequestering activated T-cells in granulomas
hypotheses.c: Enhanced local adaptive immunity in pulmonary drug-resistant TB lesions
hypotheses.statement: Fingolimod enforces lymphocyte retention in drug-resistant TB granulomas, boosting local IFN-γ-mediated control.
hypotheses.rationale: Fingolimod traps effector lymphocytes at infection sites, counteracting the immune evasion that allows drug-resistant Mtb to thrive.

reviews.critique: 可致外周淋巴细胞减少，增加感染风险
T cell sequestration may worsen inflammation; risky in TB.
强制淋巴细胞滞留可能加剧免疫病理

hypotheses.b: Inhibition of host matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) and consequent suppression of granuloma collagen degradation
hypotheses.c: Prevention of cavity formation and respiratory failure in multi-drug resistant TB
hypotheses.statement: Doxycycline preserves lung architecture during drug-resistant TB by blocking MMP-mediated collagenolysis in granulomas.
hypotheses.rationale: Doxycycline, at sub-antimicrobial doses, chelates zinc in MMPs, preventing the matrix destruction that leads to cavitary disease.

reviews.critique: 抗MMP与抗菌双重获益，警惕菌群耐药
MMP inhibition prevents collagenolysis, but clinical cavity data minimal.
多西环素抗MMP保护肺结构已有证据

hypotheses.b: Inhibition of host HMG-CoA reductase and consequent depletion of plasma membrane cholesterol required for Mtb lipid raft entry
hypotheses.c: Reduced phagocytosis of drug-resistant Mtb by alveolar macrophages and lower intracellular bacterial burden
hypotheses.statement: Simvastatin starves drug-resistant Mtb of its preferred substrates by depleting host cholesterol and activating autophagic clearance.
hypotheses.rationale: Mtb uses cholesterol-rich lipid rafts to invade macrophages; statins reduce this portal of entry and also induce autophagy.

reviews.critique: 减少吞噬或削弱早期肺部结核控制
Cholesterol depletion and autophagy well-studied; statins promising.
他汀类抗菌及自噬机制已较多报道

hypotheses.b: Nrf2-dependent host defense boost and direct envelope synthesis blockade
hypotheses.statement: Dimethyl fumarate exerts combined bactericidal and host-directed activity against drug-resistant Mtb by activating the Nrf2 antioxidant program and directly blocking mycolic acid biosynthesis.
hypotheses.rationale: DMF electrophilically modifies Keap1 to unleash Nrf2, enhancing phagosomal oxidative burst and autophagy, while simultaneously inhibiting Mtb enoyl-ACP reductase to weaken the bacterial cell wall, creating a synthetic lethal vulnerability.

reviews.critique: 同时激活Nrf2与阻断霉菌酸合成证据不足

hypotheses.b: Efflux pump inhibition restores isoniazid sensitivity
hypotheses.c: Blocks Mtb efflux pumps, increasing intracellular INH concentration
hypotheses.statement: Verapamil overcomes isoniazid resistance in drug-resistant Mtb by inhibiting bacterial efflux pumps and increasing intracellular isoniazid accumulation.
hypotheses.rationale: Verapamil, a calcium channel blocker, inhibits mycobacterial efflux pumps that expel isoniazid, allowing residual activation even in katG mutants to reach bactericidal levels through elevated intracellular drug retention.
hypotheses.self_novelty: Introduces efflux pump inhibition as a re-sensitization strategy for INH-resistant TB, distinct from iron starvation or independent oxidative stress pathways.

reviews.critique: Verapamil-INH synergy via efflux pumps well-established; low novelty.
INH耐药主因非外排泵，维拉帕米作用有限

hypotheses.b: PPARγ-mediated reprogramming of macrophage metabolism toward anti-inflammatory fatty acid oxidation and increased CD36 surface expression
hypotheses.c: Reduced tissue-damaging inflammation and improved drug penetration into granulomas
hypotheses.statement: Pioglitazone normalizes granuloma architecture in drug-resistant TB, improving drug diffusion by reducing excessive lipid inflammation.
hypotheses.rationale: PPARγ agonism decreases inflammatory monocyte influx and lipid body formation, allowing better distribution of second-line drugs into dense lesions.

reviews.critique: PPARγ激动促M2极化或抑制杀菌功能
PPARγ reduces lipid inflammation; drug diffusion impact speculative.
PPARγ激动可能过度抗炎削弱杀菌力
